observations: Photo 0: Grey/black Sharp copier with scanner lid open, control panel partly visible, no brand text readable.
Photo 1: Close-up of control panel, 'SHARP' logo visible but model number not legible at this angle.
Photo 2: Top view showing 'SHARP AR-M201' clearly printed on control panel, dust visible on lid and paper tray, screen appears blank/unlit.
Photo 3: Similar angle to photo 0, scanner lid open, unit sitting on a stand, surrounding area dark/dim lighting.
No power cable, printed output, or illuminated display showing active operation in any photo.
No toner cartridge or paper tray contents visible.
General dust and wear visible on casing; no visible cracks or missing parts.

claims.evidence: Photos show dust and wear consistent with used equipment, but 'fairly' is subjective and cannot be confirmed remotely.
No photo shows the unit powered on with a working display, test print, or scan output.
No power-on, print sample, or toner level shown in any photo.

risks.risk: Unit may not power on or may have internal faults (common in aged copiers)
risks.proof: Video of the unit powering on with main screen active and a live test print coming out

risks.risk: Toner/drum may be empty, expired, or incompatible, affecting print quality
risks.proof: Photo of toner cartridge and drum unit removed, showing fill level and part number

risks.risk: Scanner glass or ADF mechanism may be damaged or misaligned (hinges look worn in photos)
risks.proof: Close-up photo of ADF hinge and scanner glass surface, plus a sample scanned/copied page

risks.risk: Missing parts (paper trays, cables, drum unit) not shown in any photo
risks.proof: Full photo of all trays open and accessory cables included

proof_requests: Video of the copier powered on, showing display screen active and producing a live test print or copy
Photo of toner cartridge and drum unit removed, showing fill level and part numbers
Photo of all paper trays fully open and any included cables/accessories
Close-up photo of the scanner glass and ADF hinge for damage check
response.reason: The model is clearly identified as a Sharp AR-M201 from photo 2, but no photo or claim proves the unit powers on, prints, or scans, so it must be priced at worst case as non-functional; comparable listings of similar-class Sharp A4 copiers in similar unverified condition set the price band.
